Description.SourceString:
We tend to romanticise our villains, and Fuzan was no different. He was the 'dread tyrant' Fuzan, controller of the Lens, Lord of the KotHaar, and broker of the Mark. So many titles, so many stories, yet - in the end - he was naught but a bully. A bully brought to the ground, as all bullies are, eventually.

When you remove the power and threat, it's remarkable how little is left. Fuzan, lowest of all the bullies: your legacy is failure.
